1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.Nf3 c5 5.g3.strategy: Completes the fianchetto and clears the way for castling. White keeps the central tension and counts on the bishop to work along the long diagonal once the knight steps aside.
